reviewItem.question: Does "Changes to RBAC with Dex SSO Authentication: When using Dex, the `sub` claim returned in the authentication was used as the subject for RBAC" mean a change to protocol-behavior:argo-cd|name=dex-rbac-subject-claim (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: With Dex SSO, Argo CD 3.0 bases the RBAC subject on the federated_claims.user_id claim (requesting the federated:id scope) instead of the sub claim, so RBAC policies that reference the Dex sub claim must be updated to keep the same access.
